name: Machina no Kiseki ~Ogeretsu Daihyakka Gaiden~
original_name: マシーナの輝石 ～オゲレツ大百科外伝～
source:
Main character is a skilled steam mechanic engineer living in the town of Greenock. He lives in the local church orphanage with autonomous android Iris. 
One day they learn that church is about to be demolished. Protagonist needs to raise a large sum of money to save his home. Together with Iris and nun Unia they take up a job of deciphering the contents of ancient books and create devices by the sketches.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名住在格里诺克镇的熟练蒸汽机械工程师。他与自主仿生人艾莉丝一起住在当地教堂的孤儿院里。一天他们得知教堂即将被拆除。主人公需要筹集一大笔钱来拯救他的家园。他与艾莉丝和修女尤尼亚一起接下了一份解读古书内容并根据草图制造装置的工作。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
